season.name: Spring
season.line: New growth is most exposed when it is youngest.

days.t: When I see the blood, I will pass over you
x: And the blood shall be for a sign to you on the houses in which ye are, and I will see the blood, and will protect you, and there shall not be on you the plague of destruction, when I smite in the land of Egypt.
And it shall come to pass, if your sons say to you, What is this service?
that ye shall say to them, This passover is a sacrifice to the Lord, as he defended the houses of the children of Israel in Egypt, when he smote the Egyptians, but delivered our houses.

days.t: Like a lamb led to the slaughter
x: And he, because of his affliction, opens not his mouth: he was led as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.
On the next day he sees Jesus coming to him and says, “Behold, the Lamb of God, the One taking away the sin of the world!
Cleanse out the old leaven, so that you⁺ may be a new lump, as you⁺ are, unleavened. For also Christ our Passover was sacrificed,

days.t: Ransomed with the precious blood of Christ
x: knowing that were you⁺ redeemed from your⁺ futile conduct handed down from [your] fathers, not with perishable things—with silver or with gold—
but with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb unblemished and spotless,
